# Cliffco Mortgage Bankers — Minnesota

> Cliffco Mortgage Bankers (corporate NMLS #65328) is a 36-year independent
> mortgage banker headquartered in Uniondale, NY, licensed in Minnesota by
> the MN Department of Commerce (#MN-MO-65328). The Excelsior, MN branch
> serves the Twin Cities and all of Minnesota, led by loan officer
> Mitchell Patterson (NMLS #2560483). Products include conventional, FHA,
> VA, jumbo, Non-QM, bank statement loans for the self-employed, DSCR
> loans for investors, and reverse mortgages.

## Key facts

- Corporate NMLS: 65328 (verify at https://nmlsconsumeraccess.org/EntityDetails.aspx/COMPANY/65328)
- Minnesota license: MN Department of Commerce #MN-MO-65328
- Minnesota branch: Excelsior, MN (branch NMLS #2763960)
- Loan officer: Mitchell Patterson, NMLS #2560483
- Main corporate site: https://cliffcomortgage.com/
